items.prompt:

The giant isopod (whenever visible) keeps its exact anatomy and size: pale lavender-lilac glossy segmented armour, FLAT dark triangular compound eyes at the front corners of the head, short antennae, seven pairs of thin legs, spiny fan-shaped tail plate.

5.5–8.0s  The wet net rises clear of the hole. Through the mesh, only a few pale lilac armour segments are glimpsed in one corner of the net; most of the animal stays hidden. The camera settles close on the net and stops.
